headline: Best Transporting Pal in Palworld
title: Best Transporting Pal in Palworld | Knocklem | Palworld Base Guide
video_script: Who is the best Transporting Pal in Palworld one point zero? It's Knocklem, with level seven Transporting, plus level seven Mining. Wumpo's partner skill also gives other Pals at the base plus one Transporting. The best alternative is Wumpo, with level six Transporting. Tip: condense your workers to four stars to raise every work level by one. Who does Transporting at your base? Comment below!
description: The best Transporting Pal in Palworld 1.0 is Knocklem (level 7 Transporting, plus level 7 Mining). Alternative: Wumpo (level 6 Transporting). Condensing to 4 stars raises every work suitability by 1.
